prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: STL decomposition shows consistent upward trend across both folds with moderate seasonality (amplitude ~16.4). ONLY_CWT_rf dominates overall with lowest RMSE (25.04) and best seasonal correlation (0.799), while THETA leads trend correlation (1.0, tied with 11 models). High disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 58.86) and seasonality variance (0.999) combined with concept drift and autocorrelation in top models favor STL-hierarchical stacking for decomposition-aware combination. Early specialist FT_catboost (9.27 RMSE) differs from late specialist ONLY_CWT_rf (35.37 RMSE), suggesting per-horizon optimization value.
